description_en: Queries the configurations of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance that is associated with an asset. The asset is assigned a public IP address
description_zh: 查询单个公网IP资产绑定的DDoS原生防护实例的配置
name: DescribeBgpPackByIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the asset to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/472620.html operation to query the IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances, Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances, and elastic IP addresses (EIPs) within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/472620.html查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP等实例的ID
parameters.name: ip

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code of the request.

For more information about status codes, see [Common parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118841.html）
Code.description_zh:
本次请求的HTTP状态码。

关于状态码的更多信息，请参见[公共参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118841.html）

DdosbgpInfo.description_en: The configurations of the instance that is associated with the asset
DdosbgpInfo.description_zh: 公网IP资产绑定的DDoS原生防护实例的配置

BaseThreshold.description_en: The basic protection threshold of the instance. Unit: Gbit/s
BaseThreshold.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的基础防护阈值。单位：Gbps

ElasticThreshold.description_en: The burstable protection threshold of the instance. Unit: Gbit/s
ElasticThreshold.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的弹性防护阈值。单位：Gbps

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the asset

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
Success.description_zh:
本次请求是否调用成功。取值：

true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败。
